metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value: A wild set loaded with all-time favorites, the Pokémon TCG: Hidden Fates expansion is a collector’s dream and a player’s paradise! With an incredible new TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX trio, more powerful Pokémon-GX, and Shiny Pokémon galore, players will be able to discover their own Hidden Fates!
